text:
Most men will die ungrateful without knowing why.

They own everything. Shelter. Food. Education. A future. They notice none of it.

That invisibility becomes your baseline. You walk around like you have nothing, so you act like it.

Once a week, journal five real things working. Write truth. Your mood shifts. How you show up shifts.

The man who knows his abundance acts abundant.
caption: The emptiness you feel isn't real. It's invisibility wearing a mask. Send this to a man who needs it today. #discipline #mindset #selfimprovement #mentalhealth #successhabits
